---
title: "Lightbox: invalid option value"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Q1 aborts the render on an unknown `effect`. Q2 warns with a
# source-located Q-28-1 diagnostic and falls back to the default (`zoom`).
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: wobble
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: "Invalid lightbox option"
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-0.png"] > img'
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "\"closeEffect\":\"zoom\""
        - []
---
